# Lantern Light

Lantern Light is listed in the supplied catalog as a convention mascot associated with Nightmare Nights North. The [organizer's website](https://nightmarenights.org/) confirms the event is planned for October 2027 in Cody, Wyoming, but does not identify a mascot by name.

- Appearance: Unverified; no attributable reference image located.
- Name and continuity: The catalog name has not been independently confirmed. No evidence of a Hasbro television, film or comic appearance was found.
- Speaking status: No verified dialogue, voice actor or alternate identity.
- Distinction: The older Nightmare Nights Dallas convention identified its mascots as Saros and Spiritchaser in its [2014 convention press release](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2014/10/unleash-bats-twilight-sparkle-secret.html). Neither should be mistaken for Lantern Light.

## Important moments

No character-defining scenes or timestamped appearances could be verified. The announced 2027 convention is still in the future. No image is included because the character's identity and artwork attribution remain unconfirmed.
